name: Part de Hataraku Tsuma ga Me o Tsukerareta You Desu
original_name: パートで働く妻が目を付けられたようです
source:
Yuuichi and his wife worked together managing a small supermarket.
But an advisor from the main office took a liking to the wife.
Fearing that they could lose the shop with one word,
Yuuichi was helpless to to watch the advisor violate her.
